description:
Minimal, Docker-free Quarkus app that adds quarkus-hibernate-orm (on an in-memory H2 database) on
        top of the bootui-quarkus extension and proves the Hibernate (ORM mapping) advisor light-up end to end:
        the app's mapped @Entity classes are read from the EntityManagerFactory metamodel by the engine
        JpaMetamodelReader (via the capability-gated QuarkusEntityDiscovery), the shared engine HibernateScanner
        runs its curated rule registry on POST /bootui/api/hibernate/scan, and the QuarkusHibernatePropertyLookup
        maps the engine's config keys onto the quarkus.hibernate-orm.* namespace (proving, in particular, that the
        Spring-only Open-Session-in-View rule HIB-CONFIG-001 stays inert). Kept separate from
        bootui-quarkus-integration-tests (which deliberately has NO Hibernate ORM) so the ORM-absent
        not-configured path and the ORM-present scan path are each proven in isolation — the same split used for
        the SmallRye-Health and OpenTelemetry present/absent coverage.
